features.description: Add the trace renderer to src/log.ts: a verbose/TTY-aware trace surface (e.g. setVerbose/setTty config plus a traceStep/traceApi/traceGit API) that renders start markers, completion (✓) markers with elapsed timing, an in-place carriage-return rewrite on a TTY (single completion line on non-TTY), dim verbose lines, and routes every line to stderr through the existing redact() net. Foundational primitives only — no call sites are rewired here.
preconditions: src/log.ts already provides stderr routing, chalk styling, and registerSecret/redact (unchanged).
expectedBehavior: log.ts exposes a way to set verbose on/off and to detect/override TTY-ness of stderr.
A trace primitive renders a start line, then a completion line carrying elapsed ms.
On a TTY the completion line overwrites the start line in place via a single carriage return; on non-TTY only the completion line prints (no \r).
A verbose-only dim line renderer exists for the per-request / per-git-op detail lines.
Every line still passes through redact() and goes to stderr; timing uses the tool's own clock (Date.now/performance.now).
No new runtime dependency; color via existing chalk.
verificationSteps: npm run build (tsc strict) is clean.
Manual: confirm new exports in src/log.ts are pure primitives with no imports from github/git/index (no call-site rewiring).
The renderer behaviors are exercised by tests added in later features (test/trace.test.ts).

features.description: Make makeOctokit (src/github.ts) the sole Octokit factory and install a before/after/error request hook that records method, path+query, status, and elapsed ms per request, asserts the request host is api.github.com (hard error otherwise), and — when verbose — prints a dim per-request line via the trace-core renderer. Route auth.ts's default validation Octokit through makeOctokit so GET /user is traced and carries the pr-backtest userAgent.
preconditions: trace-core renderer exists in src/log.ts (verbose state + dim verbose line renderer).
makeOctokit currently exists in src/github.ts; auth.ts uses a bare new Octokit on its default path.
expectedBehavior: The hook is installed exactly once, inside makeOctokit; no per-call-site tracing in index.ts/auth.ts.
Every request through a factory-built Octokit fires the hook (verifiable with a fake transport).
Verbose: each request prints method + path+query (never body) + status + <N>ms; default: no per-request line.
A request to any host other than api.github.com throws (INV-HOST).
auth.ts builds its default validation Octokit via makeOctokit (import from ./github.js); the options.makeOctokit injection seam still works.
No traced line contains the token; userAgent stays 'pr-backtest'.
verificationSteps: Add test/trace.test.ts covering: hook fires once per request; verbose prints a line / default prints none; foreign host throws.
Update/extend test/auth.test.ts for the shared-factory routing + injection seam.
npm test passes; npm run build clean.

features.description: In src/git.ts, trace each git operation (clone, addRemote, fetch, push) by constructing a display command string from the tool's own inputs (repoHttpsUrl, SHA, refspec, remote) — never from simple-git internals or the git child's output. Use the trace-core renderer for start/completion markers (TTY in-place rewrite) and, when verbose, the $ git … detail line with elapsed time. Preserve INV-NO-RAW-GIT-STDERR: no outputHandler/progress/child-stream capture; failures still surface only the constructed 'failed' line plus the existing token-free domain errors.
preconditions: git.ts already supplies the token via GIT_ASKPASS (never in URL/argv), so the constructed command equals the real one and is secret-free.
expectedBehavior: Each of clone/addRemote/fetch/push traces a constructed argv string built from given inputs.
Verbose prints a $ git … line with elapsed time; the clone URL shows https://x-access-token@github.com/<owner>/<repo>.git with no token.
On a TTY a git op shows an in-progress line replaced in place by the completion line; non-TTY prints only the completion line (no \r).
On a forced git failure, only the constructed 'failed' line + token-free domain error reach the user; the git child's raw stderr/stdout never does.
src/git.ts adds no outputHandler/progress handler and captures no child stdout/stderr.
verificationSteps: Extend test/git.test.ts: constructed argv per op; verbose clone URL token-free; forced failure with a stderr sentinel stays absent from output.
Add TTY/non-TTY rewrite coverage to test/trace.test.ts (driving the log.ts renderer).
npm test passes; npm run build clean.

features.description: Wire the feature end to end: add the --verbose commander flag in src/cli.ts (default off, in --help, no -v collision) and thread it into the trace-core verbose state; upgrade src/index.ts step() sites (and git.ts's log.step calls) to friendly start + ✓ completion markers (§4.1 default view); keep stdout exactly the PR URL; update README to document the live trace and --verbose (incl. that shown git commands are the real, token-free commands). Add test/index.test.ts for channel discipline, default-view markers, the token-redaction net over a full flow, and unchanged op order/exit codes.
preconditions: trace-core, api-hook, and git-trace are complete (renderer + API hook + git tracing all in place).
cli.ts currently has no --verbose flag; index.ts uses step() without completion markers.
expectedBehavior: --verbose is a commander flag (default off) shown in --help; -v still means --version.
Default run shows ✓ completion markers for each operation; verbose interleaves the dim API/git detail lines.
All trace is on stderr; on success stdout is exactly the PR URL + newline.
A sentinel token registered before a full traced flow never appears in stderr, and a sentinel-bearing string routed through a trace line is scrubbed to ***.
The operation set, order, write targets, and exit codes are unchanged (success sequence + at least one failure exit path verified).
README documents the trace and --verbose and the token-free git commands; no new dependency added.
verificationSteps: Add test/index.test.ts: stdout===url+\n with trace on stderr; ✓ markers present; op order + a failure exit code match base; full-flow token absence.
Extend test/cli.test.ts for --verbose in --help, default off, no -v collision.
Add the redact()-net case to test/trace.test.ts.
npm test passes; npm run build clean; package.json dependencies unchanged.
